# Senna Filter

> Senna Filter is the website of Senna, an AI educator and creator (@sennafilter) who makes AI make sense for people without "tech" in their title. Biochemist by training, self-taught in data and AI, three-time Microsoft MVP. The site has free plain-English guides, a self-paced AI course, and info on brand partnerships and keynotes. Not related to physical filters or air purifiers.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.senna-filter.com/): Who Senna is and what she makes
- [About](https://www.senna-filter.com/about): Senna's background, from biochemistry to AI strategy and educator
- [Courses](https://www.senna-filter.com/courses): "AI From Beginner to Agents", a self-paced course from first prompt to building automations and agents. No coding experience required. Waitlist open, doors open January 4th
- [Guides](https://www.senna-filter.com/guides): Free guides on Claude, ChatGPT, prompting, vibe coding, and AI agents
- [Work with me](https://www.senna-filter.com/work-with-me): Brand partnerships and keynote speaking inquiries

- [How to Analyze a Spreadsheet With Claude (No Formulas Needed)](https://www.senna-filter.com/guides/how-to-analyze-a-spreadsheet-with-claude): Upload a spreadsheet, ask questions in plain English and get trends, totals and charts, plus how to check Claude's math before you trust it.
